rationale: C14 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are letters to the Speaker transmitting a fiscal request to Congress, and they share an unusually specific near-verbatim paragraph referring to the details, necessity, timing, and accompanying letter from the Director of the Bureau of the Budget. They also use the same formal opening and closing structure. C06 concerns the same foreign-assistance program but uses different executive-order machinery, while C09 shares only the general form of a congressional letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have the honor to submit herewith for the consideration of the Congress a supplemental estimate of appropriation for the fiscal year 1948
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith for the consideration of the Congress a draft of a proposed provision for a contract authorization ... in the form of an amendment to the Budget for the fiscal year 1949.
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the operative purpose as transmitting a fiscal proposal for congressional consideration, with the particular program, amount, and fiscal year substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The details of this estimate, the necessity therefor, and the reasons for its submission at this time are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith, in whose comments and observations thereon I concur.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The details of this proposed provision, the necessity therefor, and the reason for its submission at this time are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith, in whose comments and observations thereon I concur.
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive sentence is nearly verbatim and strongly indicates direct reuse of drafting language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Respectfully yours, HARRY S. TRUMAN [The Speaker of the House of Representatives]
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Respectfully yours, HARRY S. TRUMAN [The Speaker of the House of Representatives]
shared_material.explanation: The identical addressee and closing reinforce that C14 supplied the same letter form, though this feature alone would not establish the relationship.
